Product information:
Product Overview
These men's Japanese-style cargo casual pants are crafted from 100% cotton fabric, offering a thick texture with moderate stretch for a comfortable and loose fit. The minimalist solid color design features a drawstring closure and tapered cuffs, making them versatile for daily leisure and outdoor activities across all seasons.

Material: 100% Cotton
Style: Japanese Cargo/Casual
Color: Gray, Khaki, Black
Size: 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 38
Waist Type: Mid-rise
Closure: Drawstring
Length: Full length (Tapered cuff)
Thickness: Thickened
Elasticity: Moderate stretch
Gender: Men
Season: All seasons
